examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Careers values band: a large, centred copy cell with no actions beside the turning brand globe. Edit the props in the Controls panel — give it one action and the whole band becomes a link, two and it stays unlinked.

examples.name: Product media
examples.summary: The band with a ConsoleMockup console screen as its picture (`widget`), then with a Diagram request flow (`diagram`). Both sit inset in the media cell, and the widget plays its beat while the pointer is over the band.

examples.name: Code
examples.summary: The Application Accelerator band: the claim beside a one-file code sample (`codeTabs`), drawn with a filename bar, and a quiet "Learn more" text button (`variant: 'ghost'`). A band showing code never links to its lone action, since the sample holds tabs and a copy button.

examples.name: Vertical
examples.summary: A wide console scene stacked under the copy with `orientation="vertical"` on a dots texture. The lone action is an outlined button closed by the chevron, and `linked` is off so the band itself stays unlinked while the scene plays.

site.name: Code
site.summary: The Functions band: a two-tab code sample beside the claim, with a secondary button and an outlined GitHub button.
